title: The Right Home
about: A mindset piece about finding and purchasing the right home.
description: Searching for a home is both practical and emotional. This song focuses on reinforcing the mindset that the right place will appear at the right time.
lyrics: verse 1 – Alignment & Timing
I am aligned with the right home for me
I am aligned with finding my ideal home
The right home is already moving toward me
The right opportunity appears at the right time
My house search unfolds smoothly
I am guided to the right home
My future home is easy to recognize
The right home finds me as I look
I am aligned with the home meant for me
I am in perfect timing to find the right home
Everything lines up for my home
And I move forward calm and clear
Pre-Chorus – Trust & Ease
I trust the process of finding my home
My search feels calm and clear
I am not rushed into the wrong place
I easily release what isn’t meant for me
I recognize the right home when I see it
My home search is guided and supported
I move through this process with clarity
I am confident in my decisions
Chorus – The Home I’m Calling In
I attract a safe, solid, well-built home
I attract a home that feels right
I attract a peaceful, comfortable home
A place that fits my life
I attract a home that supports my growth
My rest, my focus, my goals
I attract a home with good energy
A place I’m excited to call my own
Verse 2 – Quality & Lifestyle
I attract a home that fits my needs
A home that supports my routines
I attract a home where I can relax
A home where I can build my life
I attract a home that supports my work
And everything I’m growing into
I attract a home that feels welcoming
A place that feels true
I attract a home that supports peace
A home I can grow into
I attract a home that supports my future
A place that matches what I do
Chorus – The Home I’m Calling In
I attract a safe, solid, well-built home
I attract a home that feels right
I attract a peaceful, comfortable home
A place that fits my life
I attract a home that supports my growth
My rest, my focus, my goals
I attract a home with good energy
A place I’m excited to call my own
Verse 3 – Financial & Practical Flow
I attract a home within my means
I attract favorable terms and conditions
I attract a home that makes financial sense
And smooth, clear decisions
I attract honest and helpful people
I attract smooth negotiations
I attract a home worth the investment
An easy, supported situation
I attract opportunities that work for me
I attract stability and flow
I attract an easy and clear process
As the right doors open slow
Bridge – Emotional Connection
I attract a home that feels secure
I attract a home that feels like mine
My home search is protected and supported
Everything aligns
The right home is already moving toward me
I am already moving toward it too
My future home is easy to recognize
When it comes into view
Final Chorus – Alignment
I am aligned with finding my ideal home
I am guided every step I take
I attract a home that supports my life
The right one, at the right place
I attract a safe, peaceful, grounded home
I attract a place I belong
Everything lines up for my home
And I feel it coming strong
